title: Emo-Pop
style: teen pop genre, emotional, female vocals, synth-pop production, heartbreak, angsty
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Fifteen schools, a blurry map
Fourteen years, caught in a trap
Then you came, a shining light
My very first friend, holding me tight
We shared our secrets, dreams untold
A bond of silver, more precious than gold
Thought I'd found where I belonged
Never knew where it all went wrong

[Chorus]
Now you're just a ghost in my head, a whisper in the hall
I miss the girl I thought I knew, before you let me fall
Love and hate entangled deep, a knot I can't untie
Left me shattered, left me weak, beneath a clouded sky

[Verse 2]
Then she returned, your old-time flame
The one who hated me, whispered my name
Turned your back, a sudden chill
Rumors spread, a bitter pill
Every face a judging stare
Felt like poison in the air
Lost my footing, lost my way
Hated who I was, day by day

[Chorus]
Now you're just a ghost in my head, a whisper in the hall
I miss the girl I thought I knew, before you let me fall
Love and hate entangled deep, a knot I can't untie
Left me shattered, left me weak, beneath a clouded sky

[Bridge]
New town now, a different scene
New faces, less serene
I have friends, they're kind and true
But none of them are quite like you
They've got their people, close and near
I stand alone, fighting back a tear
Still search for that connection deep
The promises you couldn't keep

[Chorus]
Now you're just a ghost in my head, a whisper in the hall
I miss the girl I thought I knew, before you let me fall
Love and hate entangled deep, a knot I can't untie
Left me shattered, left me weak, beneath a clouded sky

[Outro]
I miss you, I hate you, a constant refrain
Will I ever trust again, through this endless pain?
Moving on, a lonely fight
Chasing shadows in the fading light.
